note: MODULE-L5-00A bounded requirement registry -- covers the mission's own explicitly-listed critical business flows (Part 22), not an exhaustive registry of every requirement in the platform. Each entry traces module/application/role/status/evidence/gap/sprint per Part 8's schema, applied to this bounded, real subset.

requirements.statement: A prospective tenant registers, is verified, and is approved or rejected by Super Admin/Operations before activation.
Tenant submits a Security Deposit; Super Admin/Finance verifies (approve/reject/record-offline) before the deposit is considered active.
requirements.evidence: FINAL-L5-05AL (approve/reject/record-offline endpoints source-verified, not yet 5-role runtime proven)

requirements.statement: Package activation only proceeds after admin approval of the tenant's package assignment.
requirements.evidence: Sprint P1 Package Approval (memory: tenant_package_assignments, 38 tests)

requirements.statement: A customer's address must pass serviceability (Service Area coverage) before booking is offered.
requirements.evidence: serviceability engine (29 real endpoints, MODULE-L5-00 scan); customer-app runtime not independently verified this program

requirements.statement: Catalog Offerings and Pricing must be configured by a tenant before the tenant is bookable.
requirements.evidence: Bookable/Visible Status Engine (Sprint 12, memory); tenant_portal UI not re-verified this program

requirements.statement: A customer creates a booking, is matched to an available/bookable provider, and the booking is assigned.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 19/20 (booking->final-record creation, job assignment, memory); no cross-application E2E test found this program

requirements.statement: A customer can cancel or reschedule an existing booking, and this must write to the same canonical booking record the creation flow wrote to.
requirements.evidence: Carried forward from the mission brief's own known-gap list ("Customer cancellation/reschedule is disconnected from the canonical booking pipeline") -- NOT independently re-traced this sprint (bounded scope); classified DISCONNECTED per the brief's own assertion, pending direct code-trace confirmation
requirements.future_sprint: MODULE-L5-07 (must re-verify with a direct code trace before either closing or escalating)

requirements.statement: A technician executes the job through a state machine (accepted -> en_route -> arrived -> in_progress -> completed), each transition audited.
requirements.evidence: Direct inspection this sprint: `mobile/staff-app/src/screens/JobDetailScreen.tsx` VALID_TRANSITIONS + updateStatus() confirmed real, not a placeholder

requirements.statement: A technician performs inspection/diagnosis and submits a quote for customer approval before proceeding with paid work.
requirements.evidence: Backend `quote_checklist` engine confirmed real (endpoints exist, MODULE-L5-00 scan); `mobile/staff-app`'s 8 screens confirmed this sprint to have NO Quote/Inspection screen

requirements.statement: Job completion triggers commission deduction from the tenant's Usage Credit / ledger.
requirements.evidence: Carried forward from the mission brief's own known-gap list ("Job completion does not trigger commission" listed as a pattern to check) -- NOT independently re-verified this sprint
requirements.future_sprint: MODULE-L5-09 (must re-verify with a direct code trace)

requirements.statement: A customer can raise a dispute against a completed job, potentially resulting in a Service Credit.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 25 (Complaints/Disputes/Refund/Rework Engine, memory: 8 tables, 4 services, 38 tests, 7 frontend pages)
